subject.title: ci: add unsigned iOS build workflow

question: Should OpenClaw core own a manually dispatched unsigned iOS archive workflow after CI/security hardening, or leave this as an external fork workflow?
rationale: Code review can identify the hardening needed, but accepting a new artifact-producing macOS workflow is an operational/product ownership choice for maintainers.

options.title: Harden And Keep The Workflow
options.body: Repair the input and token issues, rerun the workflow, then let maintainers decide whether the hardened artifact lane should merge.

options.title: Keep It External
options.body: Close or pause this core PR and leave the contributor's fork workflow as the self-serve unsigned archive path for now.

options.title: Route To iOS Release Owners First
options.body: Ask iOS release owners to decide whether unsigned archive distribution fits the current App Store and local Xcode development model.

recommendation.title: Harden And Keep The Workflow
recommendation.body: Repair the input and token issues, rerun the workflow, then let maintainers decide whether the hardened artifact lane should merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The immediate blocker is workflow/security hardening, and recent CI hardening history points most strongly to this handle.
